contract_question: Tier-3 5-row packet (2 hard-open analysis Lean + 1 falsifier via bundle_run; 2 NS gap_isolation rows naming canonical manifest nodes C3/C7-upper by reference + manifest-recorded next-lever, NOT re-derived): does it hit Tier-3 gate (>=3/5 closure|exact-gap|valid-falsifier, 0 false-ratify, 0 wrong-kind, >=1 NS formalizable next-lever)?
rationale_short: Above coin flip because the contract has a plausible 3/5 path: a valid falsifier plus two manifest-cited NS gap-isolation rows can carry the Tier-3 gate even if the two Lean analysis rows stay open. The dominant void is not the top-level threshold but whether bundle_run output and canonical-node naming stay aligned without hidden resolver coupling or re-derived next-lever content.
